fusions.name: Over the Horns
fusions.desc: A straight thrust that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Lowered-Head Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away with the blade levelled, then deals 13 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you.

fusions.name: Plough Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Hurried
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack (38% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
